# dsh-arckep
English | Русский

Shows the **balance and spending of your arckep.ru account** right inside the
DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

web UI: a small badge
with the balance in the session header and at the foot of the sidebar, a pane

l with the details,
and a settings page for the API key.

> **Unofficial.** This is a community plugin. It is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with
> De

epSeek. arckep.ru is the third-party service the plugin connects to; you need your own
> arckep.ru a

s the third-party service the plugin connects to; you need your own
> arckep.ru account and API key.
## What you get

- **Badge** in the header of an open session: the balance as `1 234,50 ₽`. It turns to a
warning col

our when the balance is below your threshold (default 100 ₽) or when the forecast
says the money las

ts less than 3 days. Click it to open the panel.
- **Sidebar badge**: the same balance (icon and amo

unt) at the foot of the sidebar, above
Settings, so it is visible on the empty start screen too, wit

h the same warning rules. Click it
to open the same panel. You can switch it off in Settings → Arcke

p.
- **Panel**: balance (with a note for a corporate wallet), spending for today / 7 days / 30 days,

the top 5 models by cost, "enough for about N days", "updated N min ago" and a refresh button.
- **

Settings → Arckep**: the API key field (it is cleared after saving and only shows that a key
is set)

, *Save* / *Delete key*, "count spending for this key only", the polling interval
(default 300 s, mi

nimum 60 s), the warning threshold, "show the balance in the sidebar" and the
interface language.
-

Russian and English interface, following the DSH language (Russian when it cannot be
determined, Eng

lish for other DSH languages). DSH itself ships English and Chinese, so a
Russian reader can switch

the plugin to Russian in Settings → Arckep. Colours come from the DSH
theme, so light and dark theme

s work.
- If arckep.ru is unreachable, the last good numbers stay on screen and are marked
"data is

arckep.ru is unreachable, the last good numbers stay on screen and are marked
"data is out of date".

The header badge exists only while a session is open. The sidebar badge does not depend on a
session

. When the sidebar is collapsed to its narrow rail it shows only the ruble icon (hover or
focus it f

or the amount), so nothing wraps or is cut off. Both badges share one state and one
panel: only one

panel is open at a time, a refresh in one place shows in the other at once, and
the second badge mak
es no extra requests.
## Requirements
- DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** or newer with the web UI (`dsh web`). DSH is a developer preview and its plugin

APIs are still changing, see Compatibility. DSH itself needs Node.js 22.19+
(or 24+); the plugin ha

s no other requirement.
- A DSH profile that includes the web app (the shipped `web` profile does).
- An arckep.ru API key with the **`balance:read`** scope.

DSH Desktop owns its own profile, `desktop`. As the DSH docs describe: launch the app once,
**quit i

t completely**, run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-arckep` (with the
`dsh` command that ships

with the app), then reopen the app. For the `desktop` profile
`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config`

## Privacy and security
- The plugin talks to **`https://arckep.ru` and its direct fallback `https://media.arckep.ru` only**

:
`GET /api/v1/balance` and `GET /api/v1/usage?days=30&key_only=...`. The host and the https scheme

are checked in code; a redirect (any 3xx answer) is treated as an error and never followed.
- **No t

elemetry, no analytics, no third-party requests.** The plugin writes no files of its own;
the only t

hing persisted by DSH is the key, in its credential store. The display settings
live in your browser

's `localStorage`.
- The key is sent in the `Authorization: Bearer` header to arckep.ru and nowhere

else. It is
never put in `cordis.patch.yml`, in the URL, in logs, in error messages, or in anything

sent to
the browser; the browser only learns whether a key is set and where it comes from.
- The plu

gin's four routes live on DSH's own authenticated `/api` channel, so they are protected
by DSH's Hos

t/Origin checks and its browser-session cookie. State-changing requests additionally
require a JSON

content type and a same-origin request.
- **Know where the key is stored.** DSH's local credential s

tore is a file in `$DSH_HOME`
(`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, mode 600). Tools that DSH's agent runs ex

ecute as the same OS user,
so they can read it. That is a property of DSH, not of this plugin. Limit

the damage: create a
key that only has `balance:read`, and revoke it on arckep.ru if you suspect it

leaked.
- The standard proxy variables that DSH honours (see DSH's network-proxy guide) apply, beca

use the
plugin uses the host's regular `fetch`. I have not tested a proxied setup.
Report vulnerabilities privately, see SECURITY.md.
## Compatibility

DSH is a **developer preview**; its plugin interfaces can change between releases, and this
plugin d

epends on the web client's slots (`conversation.session.header.utilities`,
`sidebar.footer.action`,

`settings.section`) and on `ctx.connection.fetch` and `ctx.credentials`
of the Host.
| DSH version | Status |
| 0.2.0-rc.2 (`latest`) | tested: installs (from a local path, a tarball and a git URL), loads, head

er and sidebar badges, panel, settings, key storage, live disable/enable |
| 0.2.1-alpha.2 (`alpha`)
| tested: installs from a tarball, loads, header and sidebar badges, panel, settings, key storage |

Only the web UI (`dsh web`) was exercised. The TUI has no web client and is not supported; the
autho
r has not tested the desktop app (install steps for it are above).
